yaya.plugin.providers.label: Model providers
yaya.plugin.providers.desc: Lets the assistant view and configure its own model providers (disable only, never delete)
yaya.plugin.providers.err_bad_url: Provider URLs must be http or https
yaya.plugin.providers.guard_add: Add a model provider: requests and the API key will be sent to this address
yaya.plugin.providers.guard_credential: Change a model provider’s address / API key
yaya.plugin.providers.note_key_cleared: Base URL changed without a new key: the stored API key was cleared. Ask the user for a key (#Secret) or let them enter it in settings.
yaya.plugin.providers.note_disabled_acti: This is the active provider. Disabled providers disappear from the model picker; conversations already using it keep it until the user picks another model.
